full_prompt_en: A square Art Deco oil portrait shows an elegant woman in sharp left-facing profile. A golden satin headwrap sweeps over her hair and forms large sculptural folds above the ear, while a dark teal-black fabric plane rises behind her cheek and shoulder. Her face is pale cream with a warm blush, long dark lashes, a slender nose, and precise red lips. Both hands rest together under her chin, fingers elongated and carefully arranged. The background is almost black, interrupted by narrow bronze-brown geometric planes at the far left. The composition is close and tightly controlled, with the profile forming a clean light silhouette against the dark setting. Smoothly graded paint models the forehead, cheek, neck, and hands, yet the folds of the headwrap have crisp angular breaks like polished metal or carved stone. Light falls from the left front, catching the face and gold fabric, then turns abruptly to shadow along the neck and back of the head. Gold, cream, black, and muted teal dominate, with the tiny red mouth as a refined accent. There is no environmental narrative; pose, material, and geometry carry the image. The overall effect is glamorous, reserved, and architecturally precise, balancing sensual skin with hard stylized form.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰艺术油画肖像描绘一位优雅女子清楚朝左的侧面。金色缎头巾盖住头发，在耳上形成大片雕塑般褶皱，深青黑布面在面颊与肩后升起。脸是浅奶油色，带暖红晕、长深睫毛、纤细鼻和准确红唇。双手相合托在下巴下，手指拉长而细致安排。背景近黑，仅在最左侧有窄青铜棕几何平面。构图贴近且严格控制，侧面在深底上形成干净浅色剪影。平滑渐层颜料塑造额、颊、颈和手，但头巾褶皱有像抛光金属或雕石的清楚棱角转折。光从左前方落在脸与金布上，沿颈和后脑迅速转暗。金、奶油、黑与低调青绿占主导，小红唇是精致点缀。没有环境故事；姿态、材料和几何承担图像。整体华丽、克制且建筑般准确，以感官皮肤平衡坚硬风格化形体。
style_prompt_en: Art Deco painting turns rounded forms into smooth luminous planes bounded by crisp angular folds. Gold, cream, black, muted teal, and a tiny red accent create a luxurious restricted palette. Directional light gives pale surfaces polished volume, while dark fabric and ground merge into broad shadow masses. Hands and facial contours are elongated with deliberate elegance. Background geometry stays minimal and flat, letting silhouette and material contrast carry the composition. Edges are exact where light meets darkness and softer within blended skin. The result is poised, glamorous, and controlled.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰艺术绘画把圆润形体化为平滑发亮平面，由清晰棱角布褶界定。金、奶油、黑、低调青绿与极小红色点组成华贵受限配色。定向光让浅面有抛光体积，深布与背景则合成宽阔暗团。手与脸部轮廓被有意拉长，显得优雅。背景几何极简平坦，让剪影与材质对比承载构图。光暗交界处边缘准确，调和皮肤内部较柔。结果端正、华丽而受控。
theme_en: An elegant woman in a gold headwrap seen in profile
theme_zh: 戴金色头巾的优雅女子侧面
name: Tamara de Lempicka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
